Enrique Morán Romero, the president of Index Nuevo Laredo, has been elected to lead Mexico's national maquiladora and export-manufacturing industry association, according to El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo. Morán Romero was chosen as president-elect of the Consejo Nacional de la Industria Maquiladora y Manufacturera de Exportación, known as Index Nacional, for the 2027-2028 term.

The election took place during the association's General Ordinary Assembly, held as part of the 51st National Index Convention in Monterrey, Nuevo León, according to industry outlet T21. Morán Romero was one of three candidates whose profiles and work proposals were reviewed before the assembly vote, T21 reported.

His term is set to begin in January 2027, when he will succeed Humberto Martínez Cantú as head of the national organization, according to Mexico Industry. Morán Romero has led Index Nuevo Laredo through the 2024-2025 and 2026 terms, the latter after his re-election as president of the local board. El Mañana notes he has more than 30 years in the manufacturing industry, working on nearshoring, competitiveness, regional linkage and talent development along the northern border.

During his campaign, Morán Romero centered his platform on legal certainty, infrastructure development, workforce training and stronger productive linkages between suppliers and manufacturers, according to T21. Those priorities land at a sensitive moment for export manufacturing, with the review of the U.S.-Mexico-Canada Agreement ahead, along with questions about energy availability and regional supply chains.

For the Laredo-Nuevo Laredo border, the appointment carries particular weight. Nuevo Laredo's maquiladora sector is deeply tied to cross-border trade through Laredo's ports of entry, and Morán Romero has repeatedly pointed to the importance of international crossings and operating conditions on the northern border for companies that move components and finished goods between Mexico and the United States.

Sources:

  • El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo, "Eligen a Enrique Morán Romero presidente nacional de Index," October 29, 2026
  • T21, "Enrique Morán, nuevo presidente de Index Nacional para el periodo 2027-2028," October 2026
  • Mexico Industry, "Enrique Morán Romero será presidente de Index Nacional para el periodo 2027-2028," October 2026

title: Nuevo Laredo's Enrique Morán elected to lead Mexico's national export-manufacturing association
